items.title: Descent of the flat-at-primes condition along a surjective map on the relevant closed sets
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma descends the flat-at-primes-over condition along an algebra map whose induced map on the closed sets defined by the two ideals is surjective and which is flat at the primes in question. The proof is a localisation chase: given a prime of the source lying over the ideal, surjectivity of the map on closed sets produces a prime of the target lying over it with a flat local map between the local rings, a prime of the tensor product is chosen over both, and the module becomes flat over the source after localising because it is flat after the flat base change, which is exactly the content of the flat-going-down lemma. The chain of localisations is spelled out.
